description: A React component for an account management page, including form handling, server-side data fetching, and user account updates.

methods.name: handleInputChange
methods.description: Updates form data state when user inputs change.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, sends PUT request to update user account, and manages notices based on response.

methods.name: getServerSideProps
methods.description: Fetches user account data on server side for initial page rendering, redirects if no token.
